title: MAIN THEME EPISODE 14: ABSOLVED WILL BE THE SEEKERS OPEN
lines: 01 MAIN THEME EPISODE 14: ABSOLVED WILL BE THE SEEKERS
DURATION: October 31, 2024, 10:00 - November 14, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, EP14 Absolved Will Be the Seekers entry requirement will be lowered, becoming available to players who have completed Main Theme 1-10. Emergency Inhibitors and drop rate enhancing items will be available for a limited time.
Note:

After November 14, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7), Absolved Will Be the Seekers stages will have their level requirement reverted, requiring players to clear Main Theme 13-22 to unlock. Limited-time drops in EP14 will also end and be replaced with permanent drops. Any EP14 progress made during the event, including first clear rewards, will not be reset after the event.
[War Reserve]
DURATION: October 31, 2024, 10:00 - November 14, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, for every certain amount of Sanity spent on Main Theme or Resource Collection stages, players will obtain Emergency Sanity Samplers and Rhodes Island Supplies VII. Collect Rewards before: November 21, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7).
REWARDS: Emergency Sanity Sampler, Rhodes Island Supplies VII
[Hidden Front]
DETAILS: Players can command their squads, decide how they'll handle encounters, and complete Frontline Missions to earn rewards.
REWARDS: Event Icon 'Hidden Lifeline', Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Skill Summary, etc.
[Secret Place]
DETAILS: By clearing Main Theme: Absolved Will Be the Seekers and [Secret Place] event stages, players can obtain event rewards, and unlock confidential recordings in [Secret Place].
REWARDS: [★★★★★★: Civilight Eterna], Civilight Eterna's token
[Strategic Arsenal]
DURATION: October 31, 2024, 10:00 - November 21, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can collect [Emergency Inhibitor] by clearing Absolved Will Be the Seekers stages, and redeeming from Event Store.

REWARDS: Airship Abode Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, [★★★★★: Scene], Scene's Token, Vitafield [Rewilder] Series Classics - Legacy for Siege, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
Note:

- After November 14, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7), Emergency Inhibitors will no longer drop from EP14. Hidden Front and Secret Place will become permanent modes within EP14 , which players can continue to play after progressing to EP14. Any progress made and rewards claimed during the event will not be reset.
- Please refer to the official introduction for more details.
02 L IMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – OUR KIND
DURATION: October 31, 2024, 10:00 - November 14, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the Limited-time Headhunting, [OUR KIND], the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Wiš'adel [Limited] / Logos
★★★★★★: Muelsyse [Limited] / Texas the Omertosa [Limited] / Specter the Unchained [Limited]
★★★★★: Fang the Fire-Sharpened

In this [Limited Headhunting], players will get the limited Operator Wiš'adel after a total of 300 rolls (once only) . This special 6-star Operator is a bonus gift that does not give [Headhunting Data Contracts], and does not affect the chance to get next 6-star Operator in this [Limited Headhunting]. This count is reset at the end of this [Limited Headhunting].
NOTE:
- [OUR KIND] is part of the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] headhunting series.
- [Limited Headhunting - Celebration] is Limited Headhunting.
- Logos and Fang the Fire-Sharpened will become available in [Standard Headhunting] after November 14, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).

- Operator W will be available in the [Headhunting Data Contract Shop] during [Limited Headhunting - Celebration]. The required Headhunting Data Contracts for W will be reduced from 300 to 200 starting this headhunting.
The required Headhunting Data Contracts for previous limited Operators will also gradually reduce in future updates after they have been available for a certain period.
Available Operators from the current [Headhunting Data Contract Shop]:
★★★★★★ (300 Headhunting Data Contract): Wiš'adel / Logos / Muelsyse / Texas the Omertosa / Specter the Unchained / Nearl the Radiant Knight / Skadi the Corrupting Heart / Rosmontis
★★★★★★ (200 Headhunting Data Contract): W
★★★★★ (75 Headhunting Data Contract): Fang the Fire-Sharpened
- Wiš'adel is currently ONLY available from the [Limited Headhunting - Celebration], and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting.
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.

06 CALLIPERS VALLEY MINING AREA PROVISIONAL MINING PERMIT
DURATION: October 31, 2024, 10:00 - November 14, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event period, players can conduct one mining operation per day in "Callipers Valley Mining Area", and the possible types of ores that can be extracted from each mining operation include: Originium Crude Ore, Originium Ore, Originium Vein. The mined ore will be processed directly into Orundum.

- Originium Crude Ore is worth 400 Orundums, Originium Vein is worth 1000 Orundums, and Originium Ore's value varies between Originium Crude Ore and Originium Vein, the exact value of which will be shown after it has been processed.
- Players can only perform one mining operation per day, and the number of operations will be reset at 04:00 AM, and cannot be accumulated.

- If daily mining operation fails to tap into an Originium Vein, the probability of tapping into an Originium Vein is increased the next time, and if players tap into an Originium Vein, the vein point will disappear.

- The mining operation was divided into three phases: [1st to 5th], [6th to 10th] and [11th to 14th]. If players have not mined an Originium Vein by the end of each phase, a Rhodes Island survey team will be guided to the Originium Vein on the last day of the phase, and players will receive 1,000 Orundum for mining it.
07 ABSOLVED WILL BE THE SEEKERS ENCOURAGE EVENT OPEN
DURATION: October 31, 2024, 10:00 - November 14, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, failing to clear stages in Absolved Will Be the Seekers will refund all Sanity consumed. Starting from the version update on October 31, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7), failing to clear stages in Main Theme, SideStory, Intermezzi and Challenge Modes in SideStory will only consume 1 Sanity except for the Absolved Will Be the Seekers stages during the event.
08 CLASS CONVERSION SYSTEM UPDATE
START AT: October 31, 2024, 10:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: Players can unlock Amiya's Incantation Medic form after meeting certain requirements. Unlock requirement: Players must clear Main Story 14-21 with their own Amiya at Elite 2 in the squad, and clear Main Story 14-22 in any operational environment with their own Amiya (default form) in the squad.
